notes.title: Ai Vpet Workshop Global Contest Round 2 is Underway!
notes.notes:
Ai Vpet has been loved by everyone since its launch, and the workshop has become a platform for players to show their talents and unleash their creativity. In the first round of the contest, we saw the birth of many excellent works. Now, the second round of the contest has arrived as scheduled.

Contest Date: October 11th - December 11th 
Contest Details: https://www.vpetai.com/apply/contest
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073139/3ae62a0ae252de2033ddb98b13a33897de5795c1.png[/img]
The second round of the contest is divided into two stages: voting and Live2D creation. In the voting, players will vote or upload characters and voice lines, and those with higher rankings will have the opportunity to customize. In Live2D creation, creators will create desktop pet characters and win bonuses and props.

「Phase 1」Voting: Your pet, customized by you!
Event Time
Voting time: October 11-October 21
Results announced: October 22

Event Rules
This stage is divided into two modules: IP characters and voice lines.
✦IP characters: Users can vote or submit their favorite IP characters, and characters with higher votes will be recommended for customization. The official will invite outstanding Live2D creators to customize exclusive virtual pets for IP characters with higher votes.
Note: Each user can submit twice and vote three times for each category.
✦Voice lines: Users can upload their own or friends' audio clips (with personal authorization) and conduct public voting. The three voice lines with the highest votes will have the opportunity to have official customized voice lines. The three winning voice lines will enter the official voice line pool and be customized by the provider.
Note: Each user can upload once and vote three times.
Please submit the character and audio files reasonably, and the submitted data will take effect after review by the staff.

「Phase 2」Live2D Creation: your pet, created by you!
Event Time
Registration time: October 11-December 11
Upload works: October 11-December 11
Data deadline: December 12, 10:00 AM (UTC+8)
Results announcement/awards: December 12-December 20

Event Rules
Live2D creators can freely create desktop pet characters. If they register and upload their works within the specified time, they can successfully participate in the competition and win rewards. The entries can be original characters or secondary creations based on popular IP characters, but they must be created independently by the contestants. The uploaded entries must contain at least one of the official designated action pools, and the official will manually review the entries.
Event Rewards
Entry Award: All eligible participants will win a $70 cash reward and a "wakuwaku" voice award.
Popular Work Award: The top three works with the most subscriptions will win $300/$200/$100 cash rewards respectively.
Additional Award: If the creator's entry is one of the top ten characters voted in Phase 1 "Your Pet, Customized by You", the prize money will be increased by 20%.

Notes
The popular work award and the entry award are not cumulative, but the additional bonus is cumulative;
The uploaded work must contain one of the official specified actions;
Participants can upload multiple times, but can only win the reward once.
It is prohibited to directly copy or plagiarize other people's works;
The official has no right to use the entries for any commercial value;
The official has the right to display and promote the entries (mark the creator's signature);
If the contestant cannot be contacted, it will be deemed to have automatically given up this competition;
✦The organizer reserves the final right to interpret the rules of this competition.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073139/703b53e0268765cce39bdc9ef4770e60f37cb390.jpg[/img]
The second phase of the Ai Vpet Workshop Global Competition has officially begun. We look forward to seeing wonderful works from all over the world, and everyone is welcome to participate. If you have any questions, please join the discord (https://discord.gg/4zAtARxHMg) and contact us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073139/f95182045dec95addf141ce190837b236d41ee54.png[/img]

Character name: Rem
Call me: Master
Detailed info:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073139/96c48a3692aa33e5b4c4ee7318c8c0c19bc1e54a.png[/img]

notes.notes:
A new generation of smart desktop pet Ai Vpet pendant system: create a unique desktop for everyone!
In this digital age, personalization has long become part of our pursuit, and we always hope that they can reflect our unique self. The new generation of desktop pet software Ai Vpet breaks the limitations of traditional desktop pets and creates highly personalized and intelligent desktop partners for players. The latest widget function allows everyone to easily personalize their own desktop.
Steam download: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3029820/

notes.title: Ai Vpet Steam Demo Closed Test Starts Announcement
notes.notes:
AiVpet closed test will start on July 4, 8:00 PM (PT)!

Scope of closed testers: 200

Qualifications: Join the player group and apply

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073139/6bbb5965a2313abe96f96a65da4f3454a7d6895d.gif[/img]
This Steam Demo test version does not represent the content of the public beta version. There is still a lot of new content under development, so stay tuned!

[h1]Ai Vpet Demo1.0 Content Preview[/h1]
[h2]Interactive Chat[/h2]
The software provides three conversation modes: voice wake-up, voice conversation and text conversation. The voice wake-up mode is enabled by default after startup.
Move the mouse to the character, and the corresponding dialogue setting button and input box will be displayed for operation.

[h2]Voice wake-up[/h2]
After turning on voice wake-up and connecting the microphone, say the wake-up word "Nana" into the microphone, and after the character responds and makes a listening gesture, you can start the conversation.

[h2]Voice Chat[/h2]
After turning off the voice wake-up mode, the input box will switch to voice input mode.
Users can send voice to the virtual pet through the microphone to have a conversation.

[h2]Text Chat[/h2]
After turning off the voice wake-up mode, the input box will switch to text input mode.
Users can input text to the virtual pet and have a conversation.

[h2]Character Interaction[/h2]
Click on the character model to interact with the virtual pet.
Click on the following areas to trigger the character's interactive actions and interactive dialogue: head, body, legs, left hand and right hand.

[h2]Character settings[/h2]
The software can customize person and pet. The specific settings are as follows.
Person: role, skin, character, voice
Pets: pet role, pet skin
Move the mouse to the role, click the menu button, open the menu interface to set.

[h1]Testing subsequent update plans[/h1]
We will open the workshop function module in the future, and players can upload resources to the workshop to customize their own AI virtual pets, share their own works, and subscribe to other people's resources.
(The specific resources supported by the Workshop are as follows: role models, pet models, character settings, and voices)
